items.name: Consolidated backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: Curtiss-Wright reported backlog of $4.5 billion, up 10% from December 31, 2025, reflecting strong demand across the A&D and Commercial markets.
items.source_excerpt: Backlog of $4.5 billion, up 10% from December 31, 2025, reflecting strong demand across the A&D and Commercial markets.

items.name: Exlar GTX Series integrated motor/actuators
items.claim: Curtiss-Wright's Exlar GTX Series integrated motor/actuators offer continuous force ratings up to 2,668N (600 lbf) and speeds to 1,016 mm/sec (40 in/sec) in VAC and VDC power options.
items.source_excerpt: With continuous force ratings up to 2,668N (600 lbf) and speeds to 1,016 mm/sec (40 in/sec) in both VAC and VDC power options, the GTX060’s compact form can be applied across a wide range of automation applications.

notes: Q2 2026 8-K (stored) discloses consolidated backlog; the Exlar Actuation Division press release (stored 2026-09-14, REQ-20260914-1378) covers the GTX Series integrated-actuator product relevant to humanoid actuators.
